record.paper_title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures on Submanifolds of Finite Type: Recent Development
record.original_question: Study and classify linearly independent 2-type immersions, where a 2-type immersion has a spectral decomposition x = c + x₁ + x₂ with two distinct Laplace eigenvalues, and an immersion is linearly independent when the subspaces E₁ and E₂ spanned by {x₁(p) : p ∈ M} and {x₂(p) : p ∈ M} are linearly independent in the ambient Euclidean space.

evidence.quote: if all of the eigenvalues λ1,...,λk associated with the spectral decomposition are mutually different, then the immersion x (or the submanifold M) is said to be of k-type.

Suppose that x : M → E^m is a k-type immersion whose spectral decomposition is given by (2.1). Denote by Ei the subspace of E^m spanned by {xi(p), p ∈ M}, i ∈ {1,...,k}. The immersion x (or the submanifold M) is called linearly independent if the subspaces E1,...,Ek are linearly independent.
Problem 7. Study and classify linearly independent 2-type immersions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $x : M \to \mathbb{E}^m$ be an isometric immersion of a connected Riemannian manifold $M$ into Euclidean $m$-space, and let $\Delta$ denote the Laplace–Beltrami operator on $M$ acting componentwise on $\mathbb{E}^m$-valued functions. The immersion $x$ is said to be of $k$-type if its position vector admits a spectral decomposition
$$x = c + x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_k,$$
where $c \in \mathbb{E}^m$ is a constant vector and $x_1,\dots,x_k : M \to \mathbb{E}^m$ are nonconstant maps satisfying $\Delta x_i = \lambda_i x_i$ for $i = 1,\dots,k$, with $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_k$ pairwise distinct real numbers. For each $i$, let $E_i \subset \mathbb{E}^m$ be the linear subspace spanned by $\{x_i(p) : p \in M\}$. The immersion $x$ is called linearly independent if the subspaces $E_1,\dots,E_k$ are linearly independent in $\mathbb{E}^m$ (i.e., $\dim(E_1+\cdots+E_k) = \dim E_1 + \cdots + \dim E_k$).

Problem: Study and classify all linearly independent 2-type immersions $x : M \to \mathbb{E}^m$.
artifact.status_search_result: A full classification of linearly independent 2-type immersions into Euclidean space does not appear in the literature. Surveys on finite type submanifolds continue to list this as an open problem, with only partial results known (e.g., for hypersurfaces, spherical submanifolds, and special classes such as those with constant mean curvature or 2-type Gauss map).

status_evidence.title: Riemannian Submanifolds: A Survey (Chen)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of finite type submanifolds and linearly independent immersions; classification problems listed among open questions.
status_evidence.claim: The general classification of linearly independent 2-type immersions remains an open problem in the theory of finite type submanifolds.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems and conjectures on submanifolds of finite type: recent development
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems on finite type submanifolds including the classification of linearly independent 2-type immersions.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as an open problem in surveys on finite type submanifolds.
